descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Tehnologie, informații și mass-media
Work Model: Hybrid – 1 day per week Work From Office (WFO)
 Experience: 6+ Years
 Employment Type: Full-Time
 Job Summary We are looking for an experienced Senior QA Automation Engineer with strong expertise in database testing, test automation, and backend systems. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with Oracle databases, advanced SQL, Java-based automation, and familiarity with Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
 The role involves ensuring data integrity, validating complex data transformations, testing reporting solutions, and supporting cloud data platform integrations.
 Key Responsibilities 1. Analysis & Test Planning 
Analyze business and technical requirements, data flows, business logic, and system architecture.
Contribute to test strategies, test plans, and comprehensive test scenarios.
Estimate testing efforts and identify risks related to data integrity, performance, and scalability.
 2. Test Design & Execution 
Design, develop, and maintain test cases for data integrity, transformation logic, and reporting accuracy.
Perform functional, integration, regression, and end-to-end (E2E) testing.
Conduct database, API, and data-driven testing.
Create and manage test data for complex scenarios, including performance and stress testing.
Develop and maintain automated test scripts using Java-based frameworks.
 3. Defect Management & Reporting 
Identify, troubleshoot, document, and track defects using JIRA.
Retest fixes and ensure issues are fully resolved.
Coordinate testing activities with development teams, vendors, and business stakeholders.
Provide support for User Acceptance Testing (UAT).
 4. Leadership & Continuous Improvement 
Promote testing standards, automation practices, and quality assurance best practices.
Organize monthly project demonstration sessions for stakeholders.
Contribute to continuous improvement of testing processes and methodologies.
 Required Skills & Qualifications 
6+ years of hands-on experience in software testing, particularly in complex data-centric projects and backend systems.
Strong expertise in Oracle Database Testing , including:
Data integrity and quality validation.
Database objects testing.
Source-to-target data validation.
Advanced SQL queries.
Experience or strong familiarity with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) , particularly:
BigQuery
Dataflow
Cloud Storage
Pub/Sub
Strong programming skills in Java for test automation.
Hands-on experience with:
Selenium WebDriver
REST Assured
JUnit / TestNG
Good understanding of functional, integration, regression, performance, security, and system testing.
Experience with HP ALM and JIRA.
Strong understanding of Agile methodologies and SDLC.
Excellent English communication and stakeholder management skills.
 Preferred Qualifications 
Experience in the financial services industry.
Exposure to wealth management or financial products.
Experience coordinating UAT activities.
Familiarity with cloud data platforms and data migration projects.
Interest in adopting new testing technologies and automation frameworks.
